name: Expansion (suggestion-chip) deterministic eval v1
description: Two-step harness for the expansion flow: compose a base itinerary (discover -> compose via WorkflowExecutor), then click one suggestion chip (executor.expand) and deterministically verify the expansion contract: at least min_new_places new stops, every new stop stamped source='expansion', no duplicates against the base itinerary (case-insensitive name match — the executor's own dedupe key), every new stop validates as a CityStop, and follow-up chips (<=4) carry server-stamped unique ids. Modeled on the place_to_book_v1 deterministic gate. No LLM judge and no preference shapes — per-shape aggregation is not applicable to this set.

scoring.pass: ExpansionReady received AND n_new_places >= min_new_places AND every place has source='expansion' AND no place name duplicates the base itinerary AND every place validates as CityStop AND every follow-up chip has a non-empty unique id.
scoring.no_chips: Compose legally returned zero suggestion chips — recorded as skipped (chips_available=0), not failed, so LLM chip-yield flakiness never reads as a deterministic-gate failure.

eval_cases.author: Jane Austen
eval_cases.notes: Keyword likely matches a tea/food chip in Austen country; falls back to the first chip if not.

eval_cases.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
eval_cases.notes: No chip_keyword — deliberately exercises the first-chip fallback path.

eval_cases.author: J.R.R. Tolkien
eval_cases.notes: Oxford-centric region; single-region itineraries exercise the parent-city fallback in executor.expand.

usage_notes: Run with evaluation/tools/run_expansion_eval.py — NOT the itinerary runner (flow: expansion routes it away from run_scheduled_eval auto-discovery)
Each case costs a full discover + compose + expand pipeline (~3 workflow runs) — the set is intentionally small

The harness drives WorkflowExecutor, never the raw expansion workflow: source stamping, dedupe, chip-id stamping, and trusted-chip resolution (MYS-167) are executor logic, so a raw-workflow harness would assert nothing

The SOFT_CHIP_CAP=6 empty-chips branch is not exercised live (it would cost 6 paid expands per case); the observable one-expansion contract is asserted instead and the cap branch stays pinned by unit tests
region_selection is 'first' on every case for cost control
